notes: Chandra's Embercat (M20): its {R} cannot pay for Pack Mastiff (a Dog, not an Elemental or Chandra spell). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). With only {W} besides, the payer finds no way to pay the Mastiff's {1}{R}: the cast is refused, the Embercat stays untapped and the {W} stays in the pool.
